9781922263988.author: Blair Purvis
intro: There is more of this story than fits between the covers.
Some of it happens before the novel starts. Some of it happens in the rooms the novel walks past. It gets written here, and you get a say in what gets written next.

ballot.heading: What gets written next
ballot.blurb: Four things could happen next. Only one of them is going to. Pick the one you want and I will write it.
